capabilities: display two-hop links under the Markdown editor
show two-hop links in preview mode and Live Preview
show links at the top of the pane (experimental setting)
extras: An experimental setting shows two-hop links at the top of the pane; the README is short and points mainly at commands and a changelog.
intentEvidence: This plugin is inspired by scrapbox
motivation: To let users roam their digital garden freely, bringing Scrapbox's two-hop link concept to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian only shows direct links, so pages connected through an intermediate note are not visible while reading or writing.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by scrapbox

summary: Link preview plugin that displays pages reachable in two hops from the current note, shown under the Markdown editor or in preview mode.
